messages:
anna-partners: Quick sync: I want to align on a private-offer structure that bundles Redwood Dedicated commit + partner HW credits + SI professional services credits. Goal: make it easier for customers to buy a fully validated stack and simplify renewals. See rough sketch: https://redwood-internal/notes/offer-bundles :eyes:

raj_sales: Love it. Main ask from sales: discounted committed lanes that are simple. Can we do 3 lanes: 12m 'Base', 12m 'Growth', 24m 'Premier' with escalating discounts? Also want a renewal retention coupon for the last 90 days before renewal to reduce churn.

olivier_hw: From HW side we can offer a $150k-250k appliance rebate tied to commit band. Need to cap to 1 per account. Also can't mix with other HW promos (partner constraint).

lia_SI: SI perspective: we'll provide onboarding + 3-week POC credits for joint deals. We need clarity on how PS hours are allocated and a mechanism for invoice/consumption reporting so renewals can tie back to value delivered.

chris_finance: Quick flags: 1) Discounts should not exceed 35% combined effective discount. 2) Show both list price and net effective rate in the PO so customers and accounting reconcile. 3) Renewal mechanics: default behavior = auto-tier-down unless customer signs a new commit; need to be explicit in the contract.

julia_pm: Proposed simple matrix (sketch):
```
Tier | Redwood commit (USD/year) | Discount | HW rebate | SI credits
Base  | 250k                    | 10%      | $50k      | 60 hrs
Growth| 750k                    | 18%      | $125k     | 120 hrs
Premier| 2M+                    | 28%      | $250k     | 300 hrs
```
We should allow split-billing for Dedicated+HW within the private offer metadata so contracts/renewals can credit the right parties.

sam_engineering: Implementation notes: marketplace private offers can include 3 custom SKUs: redwood-dedicated-commit, partner-hw-credit, si-ps-credit. We'll need internal SKU mapping, a validation hook to ensure caps (1 hw rebate), and a renewal hook to map back to the original offer metadata.

anna-partners: Two outstanding Qs: 1) renewal promos — do we offer a 'first-year' extra discount that expires? 2) announcement: coordinate joint PR/partner co-marketing — legal needs 45 days notice and partner logo approval.

olivier_hw: Legal 45 days is fine. For renewal promo, HW can offer an 'upgrade voucher' for year 2 instead of a cash rebate to avoid double-dipping and protect margins.

raj_sales: For field enablement — can we get a one-pager + sample quote template? Also need a short playbook for 'renewal cadence' and customer messaging (what to say at month -3, -2, -1).

julia_pm: I'll draft the one-pager + sample private-offer JSON for marketplace and a playbook. Plan: circulate week of Mon May 5. @chris_finance can you approve discount caps before we send to partners?

chris_finance: I'll review by Fri and flag if any numbers exceed caps.

deploybot: Reminder: created GH issue internal/marketplace/offer-bundles-17482 to track SKU work — https://github.com/redwood/internal/issues/17482

anna-partners: OK next steps: Julia to draft docs + template, Sam to stub SKUs/validation, Olivier/Lia finalize partner commitments, Chris to sign off on caps. Follow-up sync Thu 10am PT? :thumbsup:

raj_sales: 10am PT works for me. :thumbsup:

lia_SI: Works. I'll bring PS T&Cs and measurement templates.
